correctness.rationale: A projective automorphism of each arrangement must preserve the unique quartic component and hence is exactly a setwise stabilizer inside the quartic's projective automorphism group. Exact arithmetic in \(\mathbb Q(\zeta_7)\) verifies three quartic automorphism generators, their \(168\)-element projective closure, the action on all \(28\) source bitangents, stabilizer sizes \(6,1,1\), the \(S_3\) action in the first case, and orbit sizes \(28,168,168\). The Hurwitz bound for a smooth genus-\(3\) curve proves the generated \(168\)-element subgroup is the full projective automorphism group.
